title: Declaration of Intended Acquisition Under Acquisition of Land Act (Grand Bahama)
text:

OFFICIAL GAZETTE
THE BAHAMAS
PUBLISHED BY AUTHORITY
NA S NSAAUSS AU 201t3h thJ aSneupatermy,b 2e0r,2 260 2 1

OFFICE OF THE PRIME MINISTER
COMMONWEALTH OF THE BAHAMAS
FREEPORT, GRAND BAHAMA
THE ACQUISITION OF LAND ACT
(Chapter 252)
DECLARATION OF INTENDED
ACQUISITION
WHEREAS it appears to the Prime Minister, the Minister responsible for
the Acquisition and Disposition of Lands that the land described in the Schedule
hereto is needed for a public purpose.
NOW THEREFORE Notice is hereby given by the Promoter, the Minister
responsible for Acquisition and Disposition of Lands, that the said land is needed
for a public purpose, namely, inner city revitalization and resilient community
re-development and for uses related thereto, and that the said Promoter intends to
acquire the said land for the said public purpose.
ALL PERSONS interested in the said land shall within thirty (30) days
of the publication of this Notice in the Gazette or the posting of the same, state
in writing to the Promoter, whether by hand-delivery or by post at P. O. Box

CB-10980, Nassau, The Bahamas, the nature of their interests in the said land,
the amount and particulars of their claims to compensation for such interests and
provide the relevant documents (if any) supporting those interests.
The Survey Plan of the said land may be inspected at the Department of
Lands and Surveys situate at Bay and Armstrong Streets, New Providence between
the hours of 9:30 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. from Monday to Friday.
Dated the 19th day of January AD., 2026.
Signed
PHILIP DAVIS
Minister Responsible for
the Acquisition and Disposition of Lands
Schedule (Annexed)

SCHEDULE
Area = 2.268 Acres
ALL THAT certain lot piece or parcel of land comprising Eight (8) contiguous
Lots numbered 73, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78, 79, and 80 (hereinafter referred to as the
said parcel of land) containing by admeasurement Two and Two Hundred Sixty-
eight Thousandths (2.268) Acres or thereabouts being the Parcel shown on a plan
on record in Department of Lands and Surveys File numbered L&S 5028/XXV
and situate immediately north of Hudson Avenue approximately One Hundred
and Ten (110) Feet east of Frobisher Drive in East Section One of the Freeport
City Subdivision in the Island of Grand Bahama in the Commonwealth of
The Bahamas ABUTTING AND BOUNDING towards the North on Drake
Avenue (Fifty (50) Feet wide public road) towards the East being partly on the
Lot numbered Eighty-two (82) and being partly on the Lot numbered Eighty-one
(81) towards the South on Hudson Avenue (Fifty (50) Feet wide public road) and
towards the West being partly on the Lot Numbered Seventy-one (71) and being
partly on the Lot numbered Seventy-two (72) or however else the same may abut
and abound which said parcel of land is more particularly delineated and shown
coloured pink on the plan of the area attached hereto.
